title: Release audit: The combined installer invokes `"$ENGINE_INSTALLER" --source ... --available-ver
summary: Define one cross-repository installer contract and implement both sides: either add an installed `forgel-install` command with `--source`, `--available-version`, and `--install VERSION` to the engine, or make Forgel Code invoke the engine's actual `install.sh`/documented command with `FORGEL_SOURCE`/`FORGEL_REF` and `--resolve`. Update both READMEs and add a cross-repository end-to-end test.
requirements: The combined installer invokes `"$ENGINE_INSTALLER" --source ... --available-version` and `--install VERSION`, defaulting to `forgel-install` on PATH. The engine repository ships `install.sh` with `--resolve` and `--uninstall` and takes source/ref through `FORGEL_SOURCE`/`FORGEL_REF`; it does not provide a `forgel-install` command or those flags. A clean default Forgel Code install therefore fails in the engine phase and cannot produce the promised working pair.
acceptance: The release audit finding is resolved: The combined installer invokes `"$ENGINE_INSTALLER" --source ... --available-version` and `--install VERSION`, defaulting to `forgel-install` on PATH. The engine repository ships `install.sh` with `--resolve` and `--uninstall` and takes source/ref through `FORGEL_SOURCE`/`FORGEL_REF`; it does not provide a `forgel-install` command or those flags. A clean default Forgel Code install therefore fails in the engine phase and cannot produce the promised working pair.
plan_goal: Make Forgel and Forgel Code install and run as one working pair: give the engine `forgel` its own installer, add a mode of the Forgel Code installer that installs both binaries together (offered by default in the README, idempotent — when the engine is already present it compares versions and installs only a strictly newer one), and introduce a declared minimum supported engine version for Forgel Code, checked at startup, so a missing or too-old engine produces a clear actionable message instead of `engine forgel: executable not found: forgel`.
